result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a section title is displaying a raw localization key instead of human-readable text.

issues.description: The section heading above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated, user-friendly text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization system correctly resolves the key 'home_feed.popular_title' to its corresponding display string (e.g., 'Popular near you') before rendering.
